With this, every edition is canon.

rulings.topic: maivori: we, with or without the listener
rulings.ruling: maivori is the first person plural, we. Whether it includes the listener (you and I) or not (they and I) is left to the context: Liraasa has no separate inclusive and exclusive forms. Where the difference matters, name who is meant: maivo ata taivo, you and I; maivori ata taivo, we and you.
examples: We sing (with or without you, as the context shows).
rulings.notes: The author's decision (2026-10-25): make it context specific.
